text: What would you say, if they threw you into a fire? He said four words.
They said: Burn him, and support your gods.
As they threw him, Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, said: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ. Allah is enough for us, and He is the best Guardian.
And Allah said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
When you're afraid today... say his words.
